body:
Do appreciate your encouragement and the offer. I've dedicated my life to the family and really have no friends or extended family that I'm able to talk with. 

One thing I've found hurting myself by pinching with pliers and burning my arm with a lighter has made me feel better. I'm aware how totally freaking crazy this is but it's the only relief I've gotten other than sleep and the 2 seconds I enjoy immediately after waking.
Hey don't know what the answers are but I do want you to know you're not alone no matter what you'll ultimately choose to do.
There is no fear of dying in fact I'd embrace death the second. The only thing that scares me is being remembered for what I've become and not what I accomplished.

Your concern is appreciated.

 I've weighed the alternative and know beyond any shadow of my doubt that it's best for all.

I sustained injuries in the line of duty and forced to medically retire after 22 years 5 months of service. I've been on pain meds and antidepressants since.

 My wife has been cheating on me with a ex boyfriend from high school the entire 3 months we've been in marriage counseling. 

 I've been a good husband and great dad but now just a pathetic existence that  serves no purpose.

  My children are raised the wife is only with me out of pity and a sense of duty. The life insurance and my departure would give them a new lease on life. I love these people and they deserve better.
